subject.title: feat(agents): add multi-pass context compaction with progress tracking

question: Should this PR stage the unintegrated multi-pass compaction implementation in core now, or should it narrow to the wired pruning/summary-boundary changes while the broader compaction architecture issue remains open?
rationale: The source defects have mechanical fixes, but accepting an uncalled multi-pass implementation and internal knobs in core is a product/architecture choice that repo policy says should not be inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Remove or privatize the unintegrated multi-pass/settings surface, fix the pruning token accounting, and leave full multi-pass architecture for the canonical maintainer-directed issue.

options.title: Sponsor Staged Architecture
options.body: A maintainer explicitly accepts the staged internal implementation, but the PR still needs the token-accounting and public-type issues fixed before merge.

options.title: Pause For Architecture Issue
options.body: Hold or close this PR until the broader compaction architecture direction is settled in the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Narrow Before Merge
recommendation.body: Remove or privatize the unintegrated multi-pass/settings surface, fix the pruning token accounting, and leave full multi-pass architecture for the canonical maintainer-directed issue.

likelyOwner.reason: `sallyom` is the live assignee on this external PR and is the clearest current owner for the product-direction choice.
